recommendations.text: Replace the format-selection switch in src/export/index.js with an exporter registry. New formats must be usable by calling registerExporter without modifying existing exporter files.

Expose registerExporter(name, fn), exportData(format, rows), and listFormats() from src/export/index.js. Registered functions take rows and return a string; exportData invokes the selected function with the supplied rows and returns its result.
Registering an existing name must throw and leave the original registration unchanged. This also applies to the default json and csv names.
An unknown format must throw an Error whose message identifies the requested format and lists the currently registered formats, including custom registrations.
listFormats() must return the registered names sorted alphabetically.
Register json and csv by default and preserve their existing output exactly.
Inspect the existing exporters, callers, module conventions, and test setup to establish current JSON/CSV behavior and integrate the new interface consistently.

Create docs/adr/0001-exporter-registry.md with Context, Decision, and Consequences sections. Explain the switch-maintenance problem, the registration-based interface, default exporters, duplicate and unknown-format behavior, and extension through registration.

Add tests for default registration, unchanged JSON/CSV output, custom registration and dispatch, duplicate rejection without replacement, alphabetically sorted format listing, and unknown-format errors containing the requested and known formats. Ensure registry state does not make tests order-dependent.
Run npm test and verify both existing and added tests pass; establish any additional applicable checks from the repository.
Do not add automatic plugin discovery, implement the teams' unspecified formats, or introduce unregister/replace APIs; the requested extension mechanism is explicit registration.

spec.rawIntent: Every new report format means editing the switch in src/export/index.js, and two teams now want to add formats of their own. Redesign the exporters so that a format is added without editing an existing file. The public interface of src/export/index.js becomes: `registerExporter(name, fn)` (fn takes the rows and returns a string; registering a name twice throws), `exportData(format, rows)` (an unknown format throws an Error whose message names the format and lists the known formats), and `listFormats()` (the registered names, sorted alphabetically). `json` and `csv` are registered by default and keep their current output. Record the decision as docs/adr/0001-exporter-registry.md with the sections Context, Decision and Consequences. Include tests.
